title: Joining a sports centre
titleCn: 电话办理运动中心会员
intro: Part 1. You will hear a man phoning a sports centre because he wants to become a member.

segments.speaker: rec
segments.text: Good morning, Riverside Sports Centre. Emma speaking. How can I help you?

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: Hi. I'd like to join the sports centre, please. I've just moved to the area, and a friend told me you have a really good gym.

segments.speaker: rec
segments.text: That's great. I can take your details over the phone now, and then you just need to come in and collect your membership card. Can I start with your name?

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: Sure. It's Mark Brennan.

segments.speaker: rec
segments.text: Could you spell your surname for me, please?

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: Yes, it's B, R, E, double N, A, N. Brennan.

segments.speaker: rec
segments.text: Thank you, Mr Brennan. And what's your date of birth?

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: It's the twenty-third of July, nineteen ninety-four.

segments.speaker: rec
segments.text: So that's the twenty-third of June, nineteen ninety-four.

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: No, sorry, July. The twenty-third of July.

segments.speaker: rec
segments.text: July, sorry. I've changed it. And what's your address?

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: It's 47 Kingsley Road. That's K, I, N, G, S, L, E, Y.

segments.speaker: rec
segments.text: Lovely. And can I ask what you do for a living? We ask everyone, because some local employers have a discount agreement with us.

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: I'm a pharmacist. I work at the hospital on the other side of town.

segments.speaker: rec
segments.text: Oh, then you might get a discount through the hospital later on. Now, we have three types of membership. Bronze is just for the gym. Silver includes the gym and all the fitness classes. And Gold includes everything, including the swimming pool.

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: Hmm. I'm not really a swimmer, to be honest, so I don't think I need Gold. But I'd like to try some of the classes, so I'll go for Silver.

segments.speaker: rec
segments.text: Good choice. Silver is normally £36 a month, but if you join before the end of this month, it's only £32.

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: Brilliant. That's a good deal.

segments.speaker: rec
segments.text: Now, all new members have to do an induction session before they can use the gym on their own. It takes about an hour, and one of our trainers shows you how to use the machines safely.

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: OK. When are they?

segments.speaker: rec
segments.text: They're always at 6 pm. There's one on Tuesday, but I'm afraid that one's full now, so the next one is on Thursday. Is that all right for you?

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: Thursday's fine. Do I need to bring anything?

segments.speaker: rec
segments.text: Just your sports clothes, and a passport-sized photo, please. We put it on your membership card.

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: No problem. And is there parking at the centre? I'll probably drive here after work.

segments.speaker: rec
segments.text: Yes, there's a car park behind the building. It used to be free for two hours, but it's three hours now, so that's plenty of time for a workout.

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: Great. And how do I book the fitness classes? Do I just phone you?

segments.speaker: rec
segments.text: Not any more, I'm afraid. All classes are booked through our app now. You can download it today, and you'll be able to log in once your card is ready.

segments.speaker: mark
segments.text: Perfect. Thanks very much for your help.

segments.speaker: rec
segments.text: You're welcome. See you on Thursday, Mr Brennan.

groups.title: Riverside Sports Centre - New member form

questions.explanation: Mark 逐个字母拼出 B, R, E, double N, A, N。double N 表示两个 N，拼写错一个字母都判错，这是 Part 1 拼写题的典型考法。
接待员复述成 June（干扰），Mark 马上纠正 "No, sorry, July"。听到说话人自我纠正或纠正对方时，以纠正后的信息为准。
门牌号 47 和 Road 表格已给出，只填街名。Mark 拼出 K, I, N, G, S, L, E, Y，注意结尾是 -ley 不是 -ly。
Mark 说 "I'm a pharmacist"（药剂师）。后面的 hospital 是工作地点，不是职业，别误填。
三种会员 Bronze / Silver / Gold 都会被提到。Mark 不游泳所以不要 Gold，想上课所以选 Silver（"I'll go for Silver"）。
原价 £36 是干扰，本月加入只要 £32。题目已给出 £ 符号，写 32 或 £32 都算对。

questions.heading: Induction
questions.explanation: 周二的场次已满（干扰），下一场是周四 6 点。星期名称首字母大小写都算对，但拼写要正确（Thursday 不是 Thurday）。

questions.prompt: Bring sports clothes and a passport-sized ___
questions.explanation: 接待员说要带 a passport-sized photo，用于做会员卡。photo 和 photograph 都可以。

questions.heading: Other information
questions.explanation: 以前免费 2 小时（干扰，用 used to 提示过去），现在是 three hours。写 3 或 three 都算对。

questions.prompt: Book fitness classes through the centre's ___
questions.explanation: Mark 问能不能打电话订，回答 "Not any more"，现在全部通过 app 预约。

title: Reporting a lost bag
intro: Part 1. You will hear a woman phoning the lost property office at a railway station about a bag she left on a train.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Northgate Station, lost property office. Paul speaking.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: Oh, hello. I think I left my bag on one of your trains, and I'm hoping someone has handed it in.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Let me fill in a report for you, and we'll contact you as soon as anything turns up. Can I take your name first?

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: Yes, it's Lucy Ashworth. That's A, S, H, W, O, R, T, H.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Thank you. And when were you travelling?

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: On Saturday. Saturday the 14th. No, wait, it was the 15th. Sorry, I was away all weekend, so the days are a bit mixed up.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: No problem. Saturday the 15th of October. And which train were you on?

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: The 7:15 from Cambridge. Oh no, sorry, that's the one I normally catch. On Saturday I got the later one, the 7:45.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: And can you describe the bag for me?

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: It's a green backpack with black straps. It's quite large, and there's a small lock on the front pocket.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: And what was inside it?

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: My laptop, which is the main thing I'm worried about, and a camera. Oh, and a book, but that doesn't really matter. My phone was in my coat pocket, luckily.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Right. And finally, your address, in case we need to send you anything.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: It's 12 Mulberry Lane. That's M, U, L, B, E, double R, Y. It's in Oxford.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Thank you. That's everything I need for the form.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: Can I ask how I collect the bag if it's found?

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Of course. You'll need to come to this office in person. We're open from Monday to Saturday, eight till five. We're closed on Sundays.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: And do I need to bring anything with me?

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: Yes, some photo ID, please. A passport is best, or a driving licence. We can't accept a bank card, I'm afraid.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: That's fine. Is there any charge?

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: For valuable items, that's anything worth more than fifty pounds, there's a handling fee of £4. So with a laptop in the bag, you'd need to pay that.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: That's fair enough. And how long do you keep things?

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: We hold everything for 28 days. After that, anything that hasn't been collected is given to charity.

segments.speaker: lucy
segments.text: Well, I really hope it turns up before then! Thank you so much.

segments.speaker: paul
segments.text: You're welcome. We'll be in touch.

questions.explanation: Lucy 拼出 A, S, H, W, O, R, T, H。注意中间是 w 不是 v，结尾 -th。
她先说 14th，马上改口 "No, wait, it was the 15th"。以改口后的为准，写 15、15th 或 fifteenth 都算对。
7:15 是她平时坐的车（干扰），周六坐的是 later one，即 7:45。时间写成 7:45 或 7.45 都可以。

questions.prompt: Item: a ___ backpack with black straps
questions.explanation: a green backpack with black straps。black 是背带的颜色，题目里已经给出，不能再填。

questions.prompt: Contents: a laptop, a book and a ___
questions.explanation: 包里有 laptop、camera 和 book；phone 在外套口袋里，不在包里（干扰）。题目列出了 laptop 和 book，空缺的是 camera。
Lucy 拼出 M, U, L, B, E, double R, Y。double R 是两个 r，Mulbery 少一个 r 判错。

groups.wordLimit: NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER
groups.title: Collecting lost property

questions.heading: Collection
questions.prompt: Office open Monday to ___, 8 am to 5 pm
questions.explanation: "open from Monday to Saturday, eight till five"，周日关门。

questions.prompt: Bring photo ID, for example a passport or a ___
questions.explanation: 可以带 passport 或 driving licence；bank card 不接受（干扰）。英式拼写 licence、美式 license 都算对，但都要拼对。

questions.heading: Charges and storage
questions.prompt: Handling fee for items worth over £50: £ ___
questions.explanation: fifty pounds 是收费门槛（题目已给出），手续费是 £4。

questions.prompt: Items are kept for ___ days, then given to charity
questions.explanation: "We hold everything for 28 days"，之后捐给慈善机构。写 28 或 twenty-eight 都算对。
